_comment: v3 vectors for oauth-issuer.v3.md. Supersedes v2 (whose 12 proofs are carried over byte for byte, tagged [v2]). The box compares htu with the issuer BOUND INTO THE CODE at authorize (normalised: lower-case scheme+host, default port dropped), never with r.Host. expect.code_consumed=false means the box rejected the proof BEFORE looking the code up. New proofs use RFC 6979 deterministic ECDSA (gen_vectors.py reproduces this file). Group-hash vectors are gone (no plum_issuer_group in phase 1).
